q2_gaps: capitalized PLURAL common-noun/role label used as an ordinary definite plural of its own kind ("the Keepers"): Names and casing withdraws plurals from the singular-collective common-noun default but then rules only on a plural label 'referring as a name' (the Wrens, whose members need not be wrens), so nothing decides between the Name-only individual and the GroupOf-of-keeper group the parse chose
notes: Group event plus per-member distribution rule for the distributive 'store', the distributed 'collected' modifier over the definite plural, event-Location for 'in a bin' with entity-attached LocatedIn for 'at the Watch', and the no-Name common-noun reading of 'the Watch' all follow doctrine, and no LocatedIn is asserted of the feathers. 'at the Watch' could equally attach to the storing event, but the two readings are near-equivalent here, so picking one is not a defect.
